name: CalendarHeader
description:
Combines `Calendar.PreviousPrimitive`, `Calendar.TitlePrimitive`, and `Calendar.NextPrimitive` into a single part, the row above the grid.
Pass children to arrange them yourself. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Parts of the header, such as `Calendar.PreviousPrimitive`, `Calendar.TitlePrimitive`, and `Calendar.NextPrimitive`. Defaults to all three in that order.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Calendar.Header.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
